justified_tb_changes.reason: Initial send_bit waited for a falling edge after reset release, permitting an unintended rising edge with x=1 before the first intended bit. Drive each intended bit after the preceding sample/reset release and before the next rising edge; arithmetic expected values and all checks remain unchanged.

interface_cycle_semantics: TopModule(clk, areset, x, z), all one bit. Active-high asynchronous reset sets Moore output to zero. Each rising clock edge consumes x and updates the Moore output for that bit.
static_review: Three-state Moore FSM; complete next-state case; explicit enum if/else assignments; nonblocking state update; no added ports or latency.
verification_coverage: Exhaustive numbers of lengths 1 through 10, 256-bit zero/ones/late-first-one/mixed patterns, asynchronous reset, reset during activity, release without an edge, and output independence from input changes. Final simulation performed 47134 comparisons.
